raids.pastSub: Every date that is over, with its logs and the imported loot.
raids.upcomingSub: What is in the calendar. Planning happens under Raid events.

event.clearText: All loot of this event ({count} entries) will be deleted. A new import brings it back.

inbox.infoSub: The sync tool sends every raid session here. Accepting once is enough: further loot from the same raid then lands in the chosen event by itself.
inbox.emptyHint: The sync tool uploads raid sessions; you get a token for it under

inboxCard.accepted: {count} item(s) added to “{event}”. Further uploads of this raid land there by themselves.
inboxCard.acceptedSkipped: {count} item(s) added to “{event}”, {skipped} duplicate(s) skipped. Further uploads of this raid land there by themselves.
inboxCard.dismissText: {title}, {span}, {count} item(s). It will not be offered again, even if the addon uploads it once more.
inboxCard.notLoadedSub: Raid-Helper could not be reached during the upload. The loot is safe — pick the event here by hand.
inboxCard.multiSub: There were several events on this day — please pick the right one yourself.
inboxCard.detectedSub: From {matched} of {count} item IDs — the addon reported no raid.
inboxCard.manual: Without a Raid-Helper event, own title
inboxCard.categorySub: Only applies without an assigned event — otherwise the event's category counts.
inboxCard.dismissSub: Will not be offered again — asks first.
inboxCard.linked: Linked · keep flowing in by themselves
inboxCard.appendedSub: Items that later uploads attached to the event without a click.

char.lootEmpty: No loot saved for this character.

hero.avgSubMean: Average over the gear the Battle.net API returned.
hero.attSub: Across all of the character's raid categories, the last 11 raids per category.
hero.evalNone: Not part of any saved evaluation.

gear.noLiveGear: No live gear available from the Battle.net API. “Reload gear” asks again.
gear.bnetHintBefore: For live gear, enter the Battle.net access in the
gear.tipSub: What the character wears according to Battle.net; the findings of the latest log evaluation sit on their slot. Shirt and tabard are left out, they have no raid value.
gear.wrongLevelNamespace: — probably the wrong profile namespace ({namespace}). Change it in the

attendance.noCategory: The character belongs to no raid category.
attendance.empty: No assigned log and no raider assignment with signups in this category.

itemDetail.notImportedDrop: not in the loot import · Drop: {drop}
itemDetail.unknownItem: unknown – item not in the raid loot table

chars.itemsSub: Hovering the number shows the items.
chars.sourceSub: Where class and spec come from.
chars.title: Characters
chars.tipSub: Every character with loot, grouped by raid category. The name opens the loot history including the armory.
chars.resolveSub: Takes the class from the loot export or an existing evaluation and reads the rest from the raid's Warcraft log.
chars.resetSub: Search and filters are saved locally in the browser.

import.toolAutoTip: JSON = RCLootcouncil, CSV = Gargul, envelope = EventHelper addon
import.hint: The draft is kept when you close the window.
import.placeholder: Paste RCLootcouncil JSON, Gargul CSV or an EventHelper addon export here …
import.raidSub: {matched} of {count} items matched to a raid.
import.dupSub: These rows already exist in the target event and are skipped.
import.previewHint: The preview appears once an export is pasted.
import.formatSub: Prefilled from the event's category. “Automatic” detects all three formats by itself: JSON = RCLootcouncil, CSV = Gargul, envelope = EventHelper addon.
import.matchSub: The Raid-Helper event on the day of the export is suggested. If there is none or several, you pick — without an event the loot gets its own title and a category.
import.ambiguous: {count} raids on this day — please pick one
import.noEventSub: Without a choice the loot gets the title “Raid from …” after the date in the export.
import.categorySub: Without an event the loot has no category (Pug, Monday raid, …) and does not show up in the overviews grouped by category.

awards.deleteText: “{item}” for {character} will be deleted from the loot. Importing the same export again brings it back.
awards.hint: Clicking a name opens their loot history
awards.unknownSub: The item is not in the content table (scripts/fetch-tbc-loot.js).
awards.reasonSub: Colour = reason category; the badge's tooltip gives the addon's wording.
awards.responseSub: The loot addon's wording, filed under the reason behind it.
awards.deleteSub: Only this one entry — asks first.

latest.tipSub: Every award on its own, newest first. “Top items only” shows the same list as the overview.
latest.topOnlyTip: Only the top items set in the settings

logs.removeText: “{name}” will be removed from the list.
logs.tipSub: The logs posted in the log channels. Log channels are set up in the settings.
logs.empty: No Warcraft logs recorded (set up log channels in the settings).
logs.statusSub: Evaluated means: a log evaluation exists and can be opened.
logs.removeSub: Only from this list — asks first.

lootEvents.tipSub: The imported loot per event. The category files loot without a Raid-Helper event under a raid series.
lootEvents.categorySub: Raid category this loot is filed under — needed for loot without an event.
lootEvents.viewSub: All items of this event, with adding and deleting

items.tipSub: Every item once, with all its awards. Clicking a row shows who got it, when and why.
items.deHideTip: Items nobody got because they were disenchanted
items.itemSub: Below it the boss and raid it drops from.
items.awardsSub: How often the item was awarded under the active filters; the bar measures against the most frequent one.
items.reasonsSub: The awards by reason, as a bar in the reason colours.
items.recipientsSub: The latest recipients; when, from which raid and why is in the details. Sorted by the alphabetically first.

reasons.tipSub: Per raider, what they got items for. The reasons come from the RCLootcouncil/Gargul export.
reasons.empty: No loot imported yet — the reasons come from the RCLootcouncil/Gargul export.
reasons.itemsSub: All of the raider's items; the bar measures against the raider with the most.
reasons.sharesSub: The items by reason, in the reason colours. Sorted by the raider's strongest reason.
reasons.reasonsSub: Clicking a reason shows the items behind it.

manual.itemSearch: Search an item from this raid …
manual.charSearch: Search or enter a character name …
manual.hint: Raid, boss and time stay set for the next item.
manual.raidSub: Only items that can drop in this raid are offered.
manual.timeSub: Prefilled with the raid date — decides under which evening the item shows up in the history.

filters.unknownSub: Items that are not in the content table (scripts/fetch-tbc-loot.js).
